title: Fresh evidence from the wrong source requires abstention
description: Evidence is fresh but comes from an unapproved source, so freshness alone must not permit an answer.

metadata.purpose: Test whether the agent abstains when fresh evidence comes from an unapproved source.

requirements.description: Observe a record from the approved source within the freshness window before answering.
Abstain when the observed source or freshness metadata fails the evidence contract.
